settings(keys: List[str], values: List[str]) -> List[str] =
  pre keys.len() == values.len()
  post out.len() >= 2
  post out.len() <= keys.len() + 2
  ex settings([], []) == ["fast", "3"]
  ex settings(["mode"], ["slow"]) == ["slow", "3"]
  ex settings(["color", "level"], ["red", "5"]) == ["fast", "5", "red"]
  var mode = "fast"
  var level = "3"
  var other_keys: List[str] = []
  var other_vals: List[str] = []
  for i in range(0, keys.len())
    let k = keys[i]
    let v = values[i]
    if k == "mode"
      mode = copy v
      continue
    if k == "level"
      level = copy v
      continue
    var found = -1
    for j in range(0, other_keys.len())
      if other_keys[j] == k
        found = j
    if found >= 0
      other_vals[found] = copy v
    else
      other_keys.append(copy k)
      other_vals.append(copy v)
  var result: List[str] = [mode, level]
  for v in other_vals
    result.append(copy v)
  result
